Option Explicit
Public Const LOW_STOCK_LABEL As String = "Low"
Public Const OK_STOCK_LABEL As String = "OK"

' ---- Sub AddProduct ----
Public Sub AddProduct(ByVal sku As String, ByVal productName As String, ByVal category As String, ByVal unitPrice As Double, ByVal stock As Long, ByVal reorderLevel As Long)
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim nextRow As Long
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    If FindProductRow(sku) > 0 Then
        MsgBox "Product " & sku & " already exists."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    nextRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).row + 1
    ws.Cells(nextRow, 1).Value = UCase(sku)
    ws.Cells(nextRow, 2).Value = productName
    ws.Cells(nextRow, 3).Value = category
    ws.Cells(nextRow, 4).Value = unitPrice
    ws.Cells(nextRow, 5).Value = stock
    ws.Cells(nextRow, 6).Value = reorderLevel
End Sub

' ---- Function FindProductRow ----
Public Function FindProductRow(ByVal sku As String) As Long
    Dim found As Range
    Set found = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products").Columns(1).Find(What:=sku, LookAt:=xlWhole)
    If found Is Nothing Then
        FindProductRow = 0
    Else
        FindProductRow = found.row
    End If
End Function

' ---- Function LookupPrice ----
Public Function LookupPrice(ByVal sku As String) As Double
    Dim r As Long
    r = FindProductRow(sku)
    If r = 0 Then
        LookupPrice = 0
    Else
        LookupPrice = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products").Cells(r, 4).Value
    End If
End Function

' ---- Function GetDiscount ----
Public Function GetDiscount(ByVal qty As Long) As Double
    Select Case qty
        Case Is >= 100
            GetDiscount = 0.15
        Case Is >= 50
            GetDiscount = 0.1
        Case Is >= 10
            GetDiscount = 0.05
        Case Else
            GetDiscount = 0
    End Select
End Function

' ---- Function CalcOrderTotal ----
Public Function CalcOrderTotal(ByVal unitPrice As Double, ByVal qty As Long) As Double
    Dim gross As Double
    gross = unitPrice * qty
    CalcOrderTotal = Round(gross * (1 - GetDiscount(qty)), 2)
End Function

' ---- Function PlaceOrder ----
Public Function PlaceOrder(ByVal sku As String, ByVal qty As Long) As Boolean
    Dim products As Worksheet
    Dim orders As Worksheet
    Dim prodRow As Long
    Dim orderRow As Long
    Set products = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    Set orders = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Orders")
    If Not IsValidQty(qty) Then
        MsgBox "Quantity must be between 1 and 1000."
        PlaceOrder = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    prodRow = FindProductRow(sku)
    If prodRow = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Unknown product: " & sku
        PlaceOrder = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If products.Cells(prodRow, 5).Value < qty Then
        MsgBox "Not enough stock for " & sku
        PlaceOrder = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    orderRow = orders.Cells(orders.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).row + 1
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 1).Value = "ORD-" & Format(orderRow - 1, "0000")
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 2).Value = Date
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 3).Value = sku
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 4).Value = qty
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 5).Value = CalcOrderTotal(products.Cells(prodRow, 4).Value, qty)
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 6).Value = "Open"
    products.Cells(prodRow, 5).Value = products.Cells(prodRow, 5).Value - qty
    CheckReorder sku
    PlaceOrder = True
End Function

' ---- Sub CheckReorder ----
Public Sub CheckReorder(ByVal sku As String)
    Dim r As Long
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    r = FindProductRow(sku)
    If r = 0 Then Exit Sub
    If ws.Cells(r, 5).Value <= ws.Cells(r, 6).Value Then
        MsgBox "Stock for " & ws.Cells(r, 2).Value & " is low. Please reorder."
    End If
End Sub

' ---- Sub RefreshStockStatus ----
Public Sub RefreshStockStatus()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).row
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If ws.Cells(i, 5).Value <= ws.Cells(i, 6).Value Then
            ws.Cells(i, 7).Value = LOW_STOCK_LABEL
        Else
            ws.Cells(i, 7).Value = OK_STOCK_LABEL
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

' ---- Sub ExportLowStockCSV ----
Public Sub ExportLowStockCSV()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim filePath As String
    Dim fileNum As Integer
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).row
    filePath = ThisWorkbook.Path & Application.PathSeparator & "low_stock.csv"
    fileNum = FreeFile
    Open filePath For Output As #fileNum
    Print #fileNum, "SKU,Name,Stock,ReorderLevel"
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If ws.Cells(i, 7).Value = LOW_STOCK_LABEL Then
            Print #fileNum, ws.Cells(i, 1).Value & "," & ws.Cells(i, 2).Value & "," & ws.Cells(i, 5).Value & "," & ws.Cells(i, 6).Value
        End If
    Next i
    Close #fileNum
    MsgBox "Exported to " & filePath
End Sub

' ---- Sub ExportOrdersPDF ----
Public Sub ExportOrdersPDF()
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Orders").ExportAsFixedFormat Type:=xlTypePDF, Filename:=ThisWorkbook.Path & "\orders.pdf"
End Sub

' ---- Sub EmailLowStockReport ----
Public Sub EmailLowStockReport()
    Dim outlookApp As Object
    Dim mail As Object
    Set outlookApp = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
    Set mail = outlookApp.CreateItem(0)
    mail.To = "purchasing@example.com"
    mail.Subject = "Low stock report"
    mail.Body = "See the attached low stock list."
    mail.Send
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_Open()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    RefreshStockStatus
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

' ---- Sub Workbook_SheetChange ----
Private Sub Workbook_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    ' When a quantity on the Orders sheet changes, recalculate that order's total
    If Sh.Name <> "Orders" Then Exit Sub
    If Target.Column <> 4 Then Exit Sub
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Dim unitPrice As Double
    Dim rowNum As Long
    rowNum = Target.Row
    unitPrice = LookupPrice(Sh.Cells(rowNum, 3).Value)
    Sh.Cells(rowNum, 5).Value = CalcOrderTotal(unitPrice, CLng(Target.Value))
